description: Ω11 — the Natural Command Language Layer as an upgradable ENGINE plugin (D-216). Wraps @vivim/omega-nlcl-pure (zero-dependency deterministic core, the same bytes run in the browser) and grounds every parse against vivim.mind's WorldModel. Determinism law N1: same (text, WorldModel, version) ⇒ same interpretation. The LLM is never in the parse path (N2: edge-only, opt-in).

engine.doc: interpret {text} → Interpretation (deterministic, traced, grounded against mind.snapshot@1). READ risk by kind — engines declare no risk; the surface/executor routes the RESULTING op through law.check.

capabilities.justification: Interpretation grounds against the self-knowledge WorldModel: nlcl.interpret@1 calls mind.snapshot@1 (READ) to fetch entities/ops/lexicon/rules. The language engine holds no other capability — executing the parsed op is the caller's business (the surface routes it through law.check like any root call).
